title: Exponential ergodicity and finite-dimensional approximation for Markovian lifts of stochastic Volterra equations
summary: This paper investigates the long-time asymptotics and the existence of stationary solutions for a class of stochastic Volterra equations (SVEs). To address the non-Markovian nature of SVEs, we employ a Markovian lifting technique, formulating a Markovian lift as the solution to a stochastic evolution equation (SEE) on a Gelfand triplet. Our main objective is to establish the ergodicity of this Markovian lift via the generalized Harris' theorem, which in turn yields the asymptotic results for the original SVE.
